description_en: Retrieves the Server Load Balancer (SLB) configuration of an application
name: DescribeApplicationSlbs

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target application
parameters.name: app_id

Code.description_en:
The API status code or POP error code. Valid values:

2xx: Success.
3xx: Redirection.
4xx: Client error.
5xx: Server error
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

items.description_en: The details of the Internet-facing SLB configuration

Cookie.description_en:
The cookie configured on the server.

The cookie must be 1 to 200 characters in length and can contain only ASCII letters and digits. It cannot contain commas (,), semicolons (;), or spaces, and cannot start with a dollar sign ($).

This parameter is required and valid only when StickySession is set to on and StickySessionType is set to server
Cookie.description_zh:
服务器上配置的Cookie。

长度为1~200个字符，只能包含ASCII英文字母和数字字符，不能包含半角逗号（,）、半角分号（;）或空格，不能以$开头。

当StickySession为on且StickySessionType为server时，该参数必选且有效

CookieTimeout.description_en:
The cookie timeout period. Unit: seconds. Valid values: 1 to 86400.

This parameter is required and valid only when StickySession is set to on and StickySessionType is set to insert
CookieTimeout.description_zh:
Cookie超时时间。单位：秒。取值范围：1~86400。

当StickySession为on且StickySessionType为insert时，该参数必选且有效

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the rule was created

HttpsCaCertId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud CA certificate for the HTTPS protocol
HttpsCaCertId.description_zh: HTTPS协议对应的阿里云CA证书ID

HttpsCertId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud certificate for the HTTPS protocol
HttpsCertId.description_zh: HTTPS协议对应的阿里云证书ID

StickySession.description_en: Indicates whether session persistence is enabled

StickySessionType.description_en:
The cookie processing method. Valid values:

insert: Inserts a cookie. When a client accesses the service for the first time, load balancing inserts a cookie into the response. The next time the client accesses the service with this cookie, the load balancing service forwards the request to the previously recorded backend server.

server: Rewrites a cookie. When load balancing detects a user-defined cookie, it rewrites the original cookie. The next time the client accesses the service with the new cookie, the load balancing service forwards the request to the previously recorded backend server.

This parameter is required and valid only when StickySession is set to on
StickySessionType.description_zh:
Cookie处理方式。取值：

insert：植入Cookie。客户端第一次访问时，负载均衡会在返回请求中植入Cookie，下次客户端携带此Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器上。

server：重写Cookie。负载均衡发现用户自定义了Cookie，将会对原来的Cookie进行重写，下次客户端携带新的Cookie访问，负载均衡服务会将请求定向转发给之前记录到的后端服务器。

当StickySession值为on时，该参数必选且有效

InternetSlbChargeType.description_en: The billing method of Internet-facing load balancing
InternetSlbChargeType.description_zh: 公网负载均衡的计费方式

InternetSlbExpired.description_en: Indicates whether the Internet-facing SLB instance has expired

InternetSlbId.description_en: The ID of the Internet-facing SLB instance

If the request is successful, the ErrorCode parameter is not returned.
If the request fails, the ErrorCode parameter is returned. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
